serif.name: 优雅衬线
serif.description: 人文、思想随笔、深度长文（类似纽约客/端传媒风格）
serif.containerStyle: font-family: -apple-system-font, "Songti SC", "SimSun", "Noto Serif SC", STSong, serif; line-height: 1.85; color: #2c2c2c; background-color: #fcfcfb; padding: 24px; max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
serif.h1Style: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #111; margin: 28px 0 16px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #8c7853; padding-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
serif.h2Style: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #222; margin: 24px 0 12px 0; border-left: 3px solid #8c7853; padding-left: 10px;
serif.blockquoteStyle: margin: 20px 0; padding: 12px 18px; border-left: 3px solid #c4b59d; background: #f7f5f0; color: #555; font-style: normal; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
serif.codeStyle: background: #f0ede6; color: #723223; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px;

academic.name: 学术极简
academic.description: 严谨论文、行业报告、白皮书风格（黑白灰高对比度）
academic.containerStyle: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; color: #1a1a1a; background-color: #ffffff; padding: 24px; max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto;
academic.h1Style: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #000; margin: 26px 0 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #111; padding-bottom: 6px;
academic.h2Style: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #111; margin: 22px 0 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0; padding-bottom: 4px;
academic.blockquoteStyle: margin: 16px 0; padding: 10px 16px; border-left: 2px solid #222; background: #fafafa; color: #444;
academic.codeStyle: background: #f3f3f3; color: #000; padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13.5px;

techDark.name: 科技深色
techDark.description: 前沿极客、技术布道、现代数码风格（深空灰配科技蓝/紫霓虹）
techDark.containerStyle: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; line-height: 1.8; color: #e2e8f0; background-color: #0f172a; padding: 28px; max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 8px;
techDark.h1Style: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #38bdf8; margin: 28px 0 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #1e293b; padding-bottom: 8px;
techDark.h2Style: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #818cf8; margin: 24px 0 12px 0; padding-left: 8px; border-left: 3px solid #38bdf8;
techDark.blockquoteStyle: margin: 20px 0; padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 3px solid #6366f1; background: #1e293b; color: #94a3b8; border-radius: 4px;
techDark.codeStyle: background: #1e293b; color: #f43f5e; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px;
